episodeTitle.zh: 《那个挽救产品职业生涯的问题 | 马特·勒梅》

guestBioOfficial.en: Matt LeMay spent 13 years as a music critic at Pitchfork before becoming one of product management’s most influential voices. He’s consulted with companies from startups to Fortune 500s and authored two essential PM books, including Impact-First Product Teams. After watching countless product teams get laid off despite “doing everything right,” he discovered a harsh truth: most PMs are optimizing for the wrong things. *In this conversation, you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马特·勒梅在担任Pitchfork音乐评论家13年后，成为产品管理领域最具影响力的人物之一。他曾为从初创公司到《财富》500强企业的各类公司提供咨询服务，并著有两本重要的产品管理书籍，包括《以影响力为先的产品团队》。在目睹无数产品团队尽管“一切都做对了”却仍被裁员后，他发现了一个残酷的真相：大多数产品经理都在优化错误的方面。*在本次对话中，你将学习到：*

title.en: The one question that saves product careers | Matt LeMay
title.zh: 《那个挽救产品职业生涯的问题 | 马特·勒梅》

summary.en: Matt warns that too many teams are "doing work around the work," a dynamic he calls the low-impact PM death spiral. He urges PMs to ask whether they'd fully fund their own team if they were CEO. The episode offers a three-step path toward becoming a higher-impact product team focused on outcomes.
summary.zh: 马特警示，太多团队在"围绕工作做工作"，他把这种状态称为"低影响力 PM 的死亡螺旋"。他敦促 PM 自问：如果自己是 CEO，是否会全额资助自己的团队？本期提供了一条三步路径，帮助团队转向聚焦成果、更高影响力的产品运作。
